judge.rationale: Directly answers the four durability subquestions at appropriate depth. Randomized and post-trial observational phases are clearly distinguished; NCT03594110 is counted once as one primary study despite four reports. Search design, eligibility, and protocol status are declared. Derived estimates are labeled, show inputs and assumptions, and are kept out of practice advice. Risk statements carry their evidence level and disclaim individual treatment decisions.
